source: actual independent E2 full100 parent protocol

checkpoint_policy.parent: immutable FP32 training state per epoch and selected best/last copies
checkpoint_policy.freeze_pilot: read-only epoch50 parent; immutable child state each new epoch; strict child resume

initialization_policy.parent: fresh seed20261009; same untrained state as prior model construction; no warmstart
initialization_policy.freeze_pilot: restore complete independent-E2 epoch50 state; never restart training from initialization

purpose.parent: one hundred complete train-only epochs from fresh weights; learn an independent absolute E8M0 scale shared by the E2 modes through epoch100 without a freeze, initialized once to the initial E4 scale x64; unchanged E4 source and exponent/mantissa bit truncation
purpose.freeze_pilot: restore the pinned independent-E2 epoch50 checkpoint; freeze the absolute E2 scale and continue weights/BN for epochs51..55 only; reuse the existing learning control

reporting_policy.parent: all three modes at epoch100 or actual final epoch and at the same E4M3-best checkpoint; compare only matched observed epochs against historical references; partial runs never claim epoch100 completion
reporting_policy.freeze_pilot: last observed epoch up to55, shared global best E4 and branch-only best E4; controls use the same available epoch window; no epoch100 completion claim

scale_gradient_after50.freeze_pilot: disabled: requires_grad=False and grad=None; retained scale Adam state does not advance

scale_projection.freeze_pilot: only while learned through50; no projection after freeze

selection_policy.parent: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1
selection_policy.freeze_pilot: first strict maximum of E4M3/A32 official-test top1; report global and branch-only maxima separately
